title: Patch: Omura's Activate is not offered with no enemy Unit to aim at, so it cannot be spent on nothing and start its cooldown
thread:
**Issue #4833 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4833: Patch: Omura's Activate is not offered with no enemy Unit to aim at, so it cannot be spent on nothing and start its cooldown
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

S+ #125 Omura's Activate aims at one enemy Unit and has a 3-turn cooldown. Its target is declared without `required`, and the ability has no `can_activate` (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c125_omura.rs:44-54`). So with no enemy Unit on the field:

- `legal_actions` lists `Activate { ability: "omura", targets: [] }`;
- `reduce` accepts it; it deals nothing;
- the cooldown starts, and on Omura's next turn, with an enemy Unit now standing, the Activate is still not offered.

A player (or the AI, which tries every listed Activate) can burn the ability for three turns by pressing it on an empty board.

### What should happen

Not offered with nothing to aim at, as its siblings are.

- R3560008: "Sei's and Omura's "Deal N …" aims at one declared enemy Unit."
- Sei's script (`c124_sei.rs:73`) marks the same target `required: Some(true)`, with the comment "R703: the Activate needs its Unit, so it is never offered with no enemy Unit to aim at."
- §8.12 rows 143 to 148 (Fire Beam, Scourge Mortar): "the Activate is not offered while the opponent has no Unit (R430)."

### How to reproduce

Fails on `main` (3a83bd7): `r3560008_omura_activate_is_not_offered_with_no_enemy_unit_to_aim_at`, in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_splus_b.rs` at 89644cb](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/89644cb/crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_splus_b.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`).

```rust
use jackioh_engine::testkit::PlayerId::{P1, P2};
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const OMURA: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-125";
const FILLER: &str = "core-005";

#[test]
fn r3560008_omura_activate_is_not_offered_with_no_enemy_unit_to_aim_at() {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    let mut s = scenario(json!({
        "p1": { "field": [{ "def": OMURA, "lane": 1 }], "hand": [FILLER], "library": [FILLER, FILLER, FILLER, FILLER] },
        "p2": { "mana": 10, "hand": ["stand-in (1) 1/10"], "library": [FILLER, FILLER, FILLER, FILLER] },
    }));
    let offered = s.activations_of(OMURA);
    if !offered.is_empty() {
        s.activate(OMURA, json!({ "ability": "omura" }));
        s.end_turn();
        s.play("stand-in (1) 1/10", json!({ "zone": 1 }));
        s.end_turn();
        assert_eq!(s.state().active, P1);
        assert_eq!(s.unit_at(P2, 1).damage, 0, "the fizzled use dealt nothing");
        assert!(s.activations_of(OMURA).is_empty(), "and the cooldown it started is still running");
    }
    assert!(offered.is_empty(),
        "R3560008, R703: with no enemy Unit to aim at, Omura's Activate is not offered; got {offered:?}");
}
```

Output today: `R3560008, R703: with no enemy Unit to aim at, Omura's Activate is not offered; got [Activate { instance_id: "c2", ability: Some("omura"), targets: Some([]), .. }]`. The two inner assertions pass: the fizzle dealt nothing and the cooldown was still running a turn later.

### Where

A card: `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c125_omura.rs`.

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- Mark Omura's target `required: Some(true)`, as Sei does, or give it Fire Beam's `can_activate`.
- **The other reading, for whoever triages this:** R90 and R703 let a declaration that is not marked needed "play and fizzle", so the engine is behaving by rule and the gap is the card's declaration. No ruling or spec line says Omura's Activate may be spent on nothing; row 125 is silent. If the owner reads R90 as covering it, close this as intended.
- It is the only Activate in the second half of the set that aims at an enemy Unit without a guard, and the only such one with a cooldown.
- The card's tests go in its own file (CLAUDE.md rule 6).
- A card change in play: read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first; it needs its pending patch fragment.

Found by an audit of the Stinkyscape+ card scripts against their printed text; the reproduction was run and the script read before filing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45614856007)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Omura's Activate (S+ #125, `omura`) is not offered while the opponent has no Unit, and `reduce` refuses it then, so the 3-turn cooldown cannot be started on nothing. This is done the way Sei's is: the target is marked `required: Some(true)` (R703, R3560008). Nothing else about the card changes. Its tests go in its own file, and the change is claimed with a `--plays` patch fragment.

No new ruling is needed. R703 and R3560008 already state the rule, and `required` is the existing mechanism for it. Issue #4833's "other reading" (R90 fizzle) is answered by R703: a declaration marked needed is not offered when nothing can be aimed at.

## Files to touch

| Path | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c125_omura.rs` | change | `omura()`: Omura's target becomes `TargetDecl { required: Some(true), ..TargetDecl::target(..) }`, with Sei's R703 comment. The tests module gets two new tests. |
| `spec/08-catalog/8.12-stinkyscape-plus.md` | change | Row 125's notes column (line 114): add that the Activate needs its enemy Unit. |
| `spec/pending/4833.md` | check | Only if `cargo jackioh spec check` demands it. No ruling is added, so it is not expected. |
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/<slug>.json` | new | Written by `cargo jackioh patches ...`, then its `player` note edited by hand. |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `catalog.json`, `spec/rulings/`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`, `spec/history/`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

Governing spec: §8.12 row 125, R3560008, R703, R1862000, R3550003.

## Steps

1. In `c125_omura.rs`, `omura()`, replace the `targets: vec![TargetDecl::target(1, 1, json!({ "side": "enemy", "of": ["unit"] }))]` entry with the block below. Copy the pattern from `c124_sei.rs:71-75`. Leave `can_activate: None`, the cooldown and `run` as they are.
   ```rust
   // R703: the Activate needs its Unit, so it is never offered with no enemy Unit to aim at.
   targets: vec![TargetDecl {
       required: Some(true),
       ..TargetDecl::target(1, 1, json!({ "side": "enemy", "of": ["unit"] }))
   }],
   ```
2. In the file's header doc comment, extend the sentence "R3560008: the Activate aims at one declared enemy Unit (R1862000)" with "; R703: it is not offered while there is none". Do not use the word "fizzle".
3. In the `tests` module, add `use jackioh_engine::subsystems::activate::activate_actions_for;`. It is also used in Sei's tests.
4. Add the tests below.
5. In `spec/08-catalog/8.12-stinkyscape-plus.md` row 125, after "The Activate aims at one declared enemy Unit ([[R3560008]], [[R1862000]])", add " and is not offered while there is none ([[R703]])". Keep every other character in the row as it is.
6. Run `cargo jackioh patches "Patch: Omura's Activate is not offered with no enemy Unit to aim at, so it cannot be spent on nothing and start its cooldown" --source "issue #4833" --notes "Issue #4833: Omura's Activate target is now required (R703, R3560008), so with no enemy Unit it is not offered and refused, and its cooldown cannot start on nothing. Script change only, no catalog change, claimed with --plays." --plays stinkyscapeplus-125`.
   - Then edit the written `crates/cards/patches/pending/*.json` by hand, as the Ticketed fragment in a9c2665f8d did. Set `player` to `{"title": "Omura's Activate is offered only with an enemy Unit to aim at", "new": [], "balance": [], "changes": [], "text": [], "fixes": ["Omura's Activate can no longer be used with no enemy Unit on the field, where it did nothing and started its 3-turn cooldown."]}`.
   - Leave `cards` as `[]` and `plays` as `["stinkyscapeplus-125"]`.
7. Run the checks listed under Tests and Done when. If `cargo jackioh classify` finds anything other than `stinkyscapeplus-125` playing differently, stop and report it.

## Tests

All new tests are in `c125_omura.rs`, `mod tests`. They use the existing `omura_on`, `omura_radiant_on` and `at` helpers.

- `r3560008_not_offered_without_an_enemy_unit` (copy Sei's at `c124_sei.rs:151`). For both faces (`radiant` in `[false, true]`):
  - Build `omura_on(json!({}))`, or `omura_radiant_on(json!({}))` for the Radiant face.
  - Assert `activate_actions_for(s.state(), P1, s.card(ID)).len() == 0` and `s.activations_of(ID).is_empty()`.
  - Assert `s.expect_refused(|s| s.activate(ID, at("hero")))`.
- `r3560008_no_cooldown_starts_while_nothing_is_there_to_aim_at`:
  - Start from `omura_on(json!({}))` and assert the offers are empty.
  - Call `next_turn_of(&mut s, P1)`, with P2's field still empty, and assert the offers are still empty and `s.expect_refused(...)` still holds.
  - Do not rely on a P2 play. Instead build `omura_on(json!({ "field": [BODY] }))` in a second scenario and assert `activations_of(ID)` is non-empty and `s.activate(ID, at(&target))` succeeds. This shows the offer returns with an enemy Unit, and that the refusal left no cooldown behind.
- The existing tests `r3560008_pierce_trample_excess_hits_the_hero`, `r3550003_it_sits_out_two_turns_after_a_use` and `radiant::armor_16_is_printed` must stay green unchanged.

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c125_omura`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo jackioh patches check`
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200 --cards`, to see that the AI handles the new offer set. Skip it if it is too slow.

## Done when

- [ ] Omura's target is `required: Some(true)`, with the R703 comment.
- [ ] With no enemy Unit, on both faces, the Activate is neither listed nor accepted (`r3560008_not_offered_without_an_enemy_unit`).
- [ ] With an enemy Unit it is still offered and works (the existing tests plus the second new test).
- [ ] Spec row 125 mentions R703.
- [ ] The pending fragment exists, claims `stinkyscapeplus-125` in `plays`, and has a non-empty hand-written `player` note.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c125_omura`, `cargo fmt --check`, the clippy command above, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and the classify `--claims` check are all green.
- [ ] No ignore, skip or `#[allow]` was added, and no ruling note was added or removed.

## Risks

- **Replay and determinism.** Games recorded before this change may contain an Omura Activate with empty targets. The engine's catalog-folding machinery handles shipped changes. Check that `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` and the golden replay tests in the workspace still pass. If a golden replay turns red, report which one rather than editing it.
- **Classify claims.** CI's `rust (classify)` fails if the fragment claims more or less than it finds. Run it before stopping (step 7).
- **Stale test name.** The issue's repro test lives on another branch and does not exist here. Do not cite it.

## Open questions

None. The one reading in the issue that would close it as intended (R90) is ruled out by R703's text and by the sibling cards Sei, Fire Beam and Scourge Mortar. The difficulty `medium` fits: the change is one card script plus tests and a fragment, and touches no engine or AI code.
````
